basic_details.job_title: Principle Security and Allied Services Multi-Tasking Staff – Housekeeping Services Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A 10th pass (SSC) candidate with housekeeping experience can apply for the post of Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) – Housekeeping Services at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC), Varanasi. The pay is Rs. 18,310 per month, and the job is purely on a contractual basis. The employer is M/s. Principle Security and Allied Services, a private outsourcing agency, and not the hospital itself. Applications are made only through an online Google Form, which is open from 20 November 2026 to 4 December 2026 (Advt. No. Admin/MTS/01/2026).

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to each candidate by email

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the online Google Application Form. The form opened on 20 November 2026 and closes on 4 December 2026.
Open the Google Application Form at https://forms.gle/5ksVeT5unMz7WCf9A (also linked in the Important Links table below).
Fill in and successfully submit the form before 04.12.2026. Submitting the form is compulsory to be eligible for the interview/skill test.
Give an email ID you check regularly. All communications about the interview/skill test schedule will be sent only to the registered email ID.

rows.details: M/s. Principle Security and Allied Services (outsourcing agency, private)
Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) & Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC), Varanasi
Rs. 18,310/- per month (subject to statutory deductions)
SSC (10th) pass with relevant housekeeping experience

content_sections.heading: About HBCH Varanasi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by M/s. Principle Security and Allied Services, which describes itself as an outsourcing agency providing manpower services to Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi. Selected candidates will be deployed at these two cancer hospitals in Varanasi for housekeeping services. The notice is signed by the agency's Supervisor and is printed in both Hindi and English.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification and experience for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) – Housekeeping Services is: Education: SSC (10th) pass. Experience: relevant experience in cleaning, sweeping, mopping, cleaning of drainage, toilets, utensils and crockery etc., cleaning of window glass panes/glass partitions, disposal of garbage, shifting of equipment/furniture, and any other work assigned. The notice does not mention an age limit, a minimum length of experience or any desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration is Rs. 18,310/- per month. The pay is subject to statutory deductions such as EPF, ESI and TDS, as applicable. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis through the outsourcing agency. Selected candidates shall not have any claim for regular absorption under the institution.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HBCH Varanasi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the online Google Application Form. The form opened on 20 November 2026 and closes on 4 December 2026. Open the Google Application Form at https://forms.gle/5ksVeT5unMz7WCf9A (also linked in the Important Links table below). Fill in and successfully submit the form before 04.12.2026. Submitting the form is compulsory to be eligible for the interview/skill test. Give an email ID you check regularly. All communications about the interview/skill test schedule will be sent only to the registered email ID.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview/skill test. Only candidates who have successfully submitted the application form will be considered for it, and the interview/skill test will be conducted at the company's discretion. Venue: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Ghanti Mill Road, Lahartara, Old Loco Colony, Shivpurwa, Varanasi – 221002, Uttar Pradesh. Batches: the interview/skill test will be held in batches. Each candidate will be told their date, time and venue in advance. Schedule: no interview date is printed in the notice. The schedule will be sent to each candidate's registered email ID. Candidates must bring the following in original, along with one set of self-attested photocopies: Recent bio-data (resume) Two (02) recent passport-sized photographs PAN Card and Aadhaar Card (original and photocopy) Educational and experience certificates (originals and photocopies)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HBCH Varanasi MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 4 December 2026. The form opened on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the MTS – Housekeeping post at HBCH Varanasi?
faq.answer: You need to be SSC (10th) pass. You also need relevant experience in cleaning, sweeping, mopping, cleaning of drainage, toilets, utensils and crockery, window glass, garbage disposal and shifting of equipment/furniture.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of MTS – Housekeeping at HBCH Varanasi?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 18,310/- per month. It is subject to statutory deductions such as EPF, ESI and TDS, as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for HBCH Varanasi MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google Application Form at https://forms.gle/5ksVeT5unMz7WCf9A by 4 December 2026. Only candidates who submit this form will be considered for the interview/skill test.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the HBCH Varanasi MTS post?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview/skill test held in batches. It will take place at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Ghanti Mill Road, Lahartara, Old Loco Colony, Shivpurwa, Varanasi – 221002.

faq.question: Q6. How will I know my interview/skill test date?
faq.answer: The schedule will be sent only to your registered email ID. Each candidate will be told their date, time and venue in advance.

faq.question: Q7. Is the HBCH Varanasi MTS job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual through the outsourcing agency M/s. Principle Security and Allied Services. Selected candidates shall not have any claim for regular absorption under the institution.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the HBCH Varanasi interview/skill test?
faq.answer: Bring the following in original, along with one set of self-attested photocopies: a recent resume, two recent passport-sized photographs, your PAN Card and Aadhaar Card, and your educational and experience certificates.
